Reason: Although the provided images are CT scans (sagittal and axial) rather than a chest X-ray, they clearly demonstrate a widened mediastinum with periaortic soft tissue density/hemorrhage consistent with blunt thoracic aortic injury. This radiographic finding on a chest X-ray would correspond to mediastinal widening suggestive of aortic injury, making option B the most accurate description of the pathology shown.
